linked_prs.title: fix(ai): call abort callback when stream is aborted during tool execution
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Abort signal were only forwarded to tools and fetch, but not processed for immediate stream abortion. In case of aborting during tool execution, the request stopped without calling the abort handler or attaching an abort event.

## Summary

Check the abort signal before each chunk is streamed out and stop the stream when it is aborted.

## Related Issues

Continues #8106
Fixes #8107
